# JobScout Design Notes

Recreation of ColorLib "Jobfinderportal" (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/jobfinderportal/).

## Sections

1. **Navbar** — Fixed top, brand "JobScout", nav links, Register/Login buttons, mobile hamburger
2. **Hero** — Full-width bg image, dark overlay, headline, search form (keyword + location + button)
3. **Categories** — 8-card grid with icons, names, counts, "Browse All Sectors" button
4. **CV Upload CTA** — Dark overlay section with heading and upload button
5. **Featured Jobs** — 4 job listing cards with company icon, details, type badge, time ago
6. **How It Works** — 3-step process cards on dark navy background
7. **Testimonial** — Star rating, blockquote, founder info, dot navigation
8. **Company Stats** — Split layout: text + CTA on left, image + "Since 1994" badge on right
9. **Blog** — 2-column cards with image, date badge, category, title, "Read more"
10. **Footer** — Dark bg, 4 columns, stats row, copyright with Component Dock link, social icons

## Design Tokens

- Brand: `#fb246a` (hot pink)
- Navy: `#28395a`
- Footer: `#010b1d`
- Accent: `#8b92dd`
- Fonts: Barlow (headings) + Muli (body)
- No ColorLib assets copied — picsum.photos placeholders, lucide-react icons, inline SVG brand icons
